[FMLA 04] NormalP — Normal Probability P(x)

Standard normal CDF up to x (Hastings approximation). Prompt is x; range 0 ≤ x < 10⁵⁰.

Calculator scroll name: NormalP. Standard normal CDF up to x (Hastings approximation). The calculator prompt is x, not t.

formula
P(x)=∫−∞x​2π​1​e−2t2​dt

Picture a hill centred at 0. P(x) answers: “starting from the far left, how much of the hill have I covered when I stop at x?” A larger x covers more of the hill, so P(x) is closer to 1.

keys
FMLA→0→4

Primary input: x (0 ≤ x < 10⁵⁰).

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 0, then 4 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

x = 1
P(1) ≈ 0.8413
note

Hastings-style approximation. Official range is 0 ≤ x < 1×10⁵⁰ — a negative x is out of range, not Φ(−1). For P(Z ≤ −a) use 1 − P(a), or 0.5 − Q(a) with FMLA 05.
